suggestion (medium): 🟡 **shaOf can read a summary number as the head SHA** **(non-blocking)**

`shaOf()` takes the first backticked hex, and `SUMMARY` sits above the `<sub>` line: a summary with `` `1000000` `` folds the head run as `Older run on 1000000` and drops the notice.

```js
const shaOf = (region) => (region.match(/<sub>`([0-9a-f]{7,40})`/) ?? region.match(/head `([0-9a-f]{7,40})`/)
  ?? region.match(/`([0-9a-f]{7,40})`/))?.[1]?.slice(0, 7) ?? null;
```

<sup>`pr-reviewer` · commit `1e00ba5`</sup>

suggestion (medium): 🟡 **mcp path never posts the verdict-change notice** **(non-blocking)**

`flipNotice()` runs only inside `upsert()` after its `PATCH`; this `mcp` path uses `--dry-run`, which prints the body only, so an Agent0 ✅ → ❌ re-run edits the comment silently.

```text
… write its stdout with `mcp__github__update_issue_comment`. When the script also wrote `--notice-out <file>`, post that file's text with `mcp__github__add_issue_comment` (replace `<url>` with the updated comment's URL).
```

<sup>`pr-reviewer` · commit `1e00ba5`</sup>
